content.contents: i'm trying to write a new album, i don't know
10 tracks is what i'm aiming for, thus far i've got like, 5 and a half
and if i can be honest i feel about ready to give up altogether

here's the thing. static.grl is the most susccessful project i've ever worked on, and it's something i'd like to keep going, but it's very very difficult to keep this going when i don't get paid anything and i can't write anything that sounds good. i mean, i can write the starts of things, of ideas, but at a certain point it all ends up sounding the same, and i know if i drop a half-assed album people are probably going to look away, or give it a passing glance and then shrug and look at something else that's newer, shinier, more well polished
some of the stuff on this album is sounding cool, and i'm excited about it, but some of it i'm just not happy with at all
i don't know what to do anymore

and i know this'll pass just like every other problem i've ever had but it's hard to live in the midst of the problem because i feel so hopeless and worthless and like i'm just the worst artist you've ever met
i don't know what i'm doing anymore, either
i want to write songs. i want to record songs. i want to do an album, a singing album, where i play acoustic guitar the whole way through, but that's not 'static.grl', that's someone else
i know i have to get this music done because otherwise i'm gonna hate myself again, but i just want to move on and work on something new, i'm bored
